In my app Quick Health, the "confirm fictional cases" button/toggle is stuck in the top corner of the screen and I can't tap it. Users can't use the app because of this. Please fix it.

Do the following:
1. Find the component/screen that renders the "confirm fictional cases" button or toggle.
2. Figure out why it can't be tapped. Check for: 
   - It being positioned under the status bar, notch, or safe area
   - Absolute/fixed positioning pushing it to the corner or off-screen
   - Another element overlapping it (z-index / elevation / touch-blocking overlay)
   - A very small touch target
3. Move it to a clearly visible, easy-to-reach location (for example, a prominent button near the center or bottom of the screen, or a clear row at the top of the content area, below the header).
4. Respect safe areas (use SafeAreaView / safe-area insets or the equivalent for this framework) so nothing is hidden behind the status bar or notch.
5. Make the touch target at least 44x44 px, with clear styling, label text, and enough contrast.
6. Make sure it works on small and large screens, and in both portrait and landscape.
7. Show me exactly which files you changed and explain what was causing the problem.
I’ll trace where that confirmation control is rendered and inspect its layout and surrounding overlays, then make the smallest fix that keeps it reachable across screen sizes.

content.text:
The confirmation checkbox was in Streamlit’s sidebar. On narrow screens, the sidebar collapses behind the menu at the top corner, making the checkbox hard to find or tap.

I moved it into a bordered “Before you begin” panel in the main content, directly below the page title. The checkbox row has a minimum 44 px touch height, and the page content now accounts for safe-area insets on mobile.

Changed files:

- [app_pages/demo.py](/C:/Users/HP/Documents/quickhealth/app_pages/demo.py:62) — moved the confirmation checkbox into the main content and kept the “Fictional sessions” heading in the sidebar.
- [quickhealth/ui.py](/C:/Users/HP/Documents/quickhealth/quickhealth/ui.py:96) — added touch-target sizing and safe-area padding for narrow screens.

`git diff --check` passed. I haven’t checked the layout in a live browser on different devices.
how do i commit and push

Open PowerShell in `C:\Users\HP\Documents\quickhealth` and run:

```powershell
git add app_pages/demo.py quickhealth/ui.py
git commit -m "Move fictional confirmation into main content"
git push origin main
```

If Git says there’s nothing to commit, check `git status` to see the current changes.
